messages:
incidents-bot: Pager duty: 3xx high CPU alerts for inference-hosts in us-west-2a (g5 pool). alerts: cpu>90% across 4 hosts, DNS timeouts observed for 2 of them. Pager: https://pd.example/INC-4721 :rotating_light:
sara (sre-oncall): seeing the alerts. checking host metrics and node agent logs now. tagging @mike for possible network / resolver involvement. :eyes:
mike (infra): I can see resolver error spikes from the VPC route table side, also some retransmits on eth0. pulling ENI stats.
alex (runtime): traffic to these hosts is mostly short-lived inference streams. kvcache hit rate dropping ~30%, latency bumps. switching traffic out would help if capacity exists elsewhere.
sara (sre-oncall): quickly: can we steer traffic to us-west-2b? what's the rollout cost?
mike (infra): we have headroom in 2b. I can add a temporary route rule to shift 30% of traffic for the g5 pool. will coordinate with network.
taylor (support): any customer impact visible? Support dashboards show a spike in 503s for a handful of tenants spanning low-volume users. flagging potential SLA risk.
sara (sre-oncall): marking customer-impact=yes, notifying product for comms. adding mitigation steps to thread.
incidents-bot: Runbook step 1: validate node-level CPU stalls -> run `ssh host && sudo journalctl -u inference-agent | tail -n 200`
alex (runtime): ran checks — inference-agent process is healthy but kernel sched shows high steal and CPU runq size. suspect noisy neighbor on the host (possibly hypervisor-level). logs include repeated DNS resolution timeouts: `lookup: i/o timeout`
mike (infra): starting traffic-shift: bump route weight for us-west-2b endpoint group to 30%. command: `rbctl route update --pool g5-west --weights us-west-2a=70,us-west-2b=30`
sara (sre-oncall): initiating now. will watch SLO dashboards.
(2 minutes later)
mike (infra): route update applied. verifying. healthchecks show drop in inflight on problematic hosts.
(5 minutes later)
sara (sre-oncall): CPU on the 4 hosts trending down, DNS timeouts reduced. KV cache warming slowly. latency P95 back to baseline for most routes.
taylor (support): 503s decreased by ~80% for affected customers. still a few retries but recovery visible.
alex (runtime): enabling short-term autoscale on the dedicated pool to soak load while traffic shifts. `rbctl pool scale --name g5-west --delta +4 --ttl 15m`
sara (sre-oncall): good. assigning post-incident actions: - validate hypervisor metrics with cloud provider, - run host remediation (reboot or migrate) for 4 hosts, - update runbook to include quick traffic-shift commands.
oncall-next: I'll take follow-up for host remediation and vendor ticket. please hand off.
sara (sre-oncall): handing off to @oncall-next. I'm going to file the incident and start timeline notes. great job everyone. :thumbsup:
incidents-bot: Incident created INC-4721, severity: SEV2, assigned to oncall-next. Links: runbook: https://docs.internal/runbooks/inference-az-failures
(standard postmortem reminder)
